body:
This PR changes a lot of code, and it's hard for me to tell what of this change is refactoring for its own sake, and what part of this is fixing the underlying bug.

I spent w hile reading through this code, and it was educational for me to learn how different parts of the WASAPI path fit together, it was quite a challenge to tell which parts of the code are the same and which were adjusted.

I'm a little unconvinced about the change to where `finish_input_device()` is being called, since if it's called at a different place than the `init_input_device()` then might it be possible to inadvertently leak the old input device?

I'm also concerned given the description that it's an AI generated pull request, since this would mean there is no human who understands how the rewritten code works well enough to reply to my review comments. I hope I didn't waste my time reviewing this.
